verdict.rationale: Lovable's documented AI is aimed at building apps: generating code and schemas, running Build mode, and reading connected sources as context while you build. Nothing in the evidence documents the product itself surfacing AI-generated insights or suggestions from a user's data. The built-in AI connector, read-only database queries via the Telegram bot, and the ClickHouse chat connector are building blocks or adjacent features, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
